description.en: A three-dimensional wall of real album covers: hover to lift, click to fly a cover into the center, then scroll or drag through the endless tunnel.
description.zh: 真实专辑封面组成三维隧道，悬停吸起，点击沿弧线飞入中央，滚动或拖动不断穿行。

keywords: 专辑 封面 隧道 飞入 原创 雷师傅 三维 厚度 雾 光 专辑墙 album cover tunnel wall fly hover scroll drag LeiShiFu original

discovery.caveat: 雷师傅原创交互，默认55张真实专辑封面；封面图片版权归各自权利人，支持自定义图片。

source.implementation: LeiShiFu original HTML and interaction, ported into a scoped native Three.js core shared by six framework lifecycles.
source.author: 雷师傅
source.license: Interaction credited to LeiShiFu. Album artwork is demonstration content; rights remain with the respective artwork owners. Three.js retains its MIT notice. Original attribution applies to the interaction, not album artwork.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Hover to lift a cover, click to make it the main album, and scroll or drag vertically to travel. Focus the scene for arrow-key navigation; Space pauses or resumes.
instructions.zh: 悬停吸起封面，点击切换主专辑，上下滚动或拖动穿行；聚焦场景后用方向键切换，空格暂停或继续。
